games.name: Brainrot Stairs
games.desc:
WILL YOU SURVIVE BOMBINI GUSINI?!?

Every round, one player becomes the Dropper, standing above the stairs with one job: Throw Italian brainrot creatures down the stairs to knock everyone off!

The rest? They gotta climb to the top without getting flung by a falling tung tung sahur.


 🎮 How to Play:

* One player is picked as the Dropper each round.
* The Dropper throws brainrot creatures down the stairs!
* Everyone else runs, jumps, and dodges their way to the top.
* First to reach the top wins the round!

👍 Like the game to help us make more updates!
